34: func NewCreateMarketRepoCmd() *cobra.Command {
35: 	var err error
36: 	cmd := &cobra.Command{
37: 		Use: "market repo [args]",
38: 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
39: 			// WalletDir&Account will be used to init the wallet
40: 			walletDir, err := cmd.Flags().GetString("wallet")
41: 			if err != nil {
42: 				return err
43: 			}
44: 			accountAddress, err := cmd.Flags().GetString("account")
45: 			if err != nil {
46: 				return err
47: 			}
48: 
49: 			// read repository url
50: 			repoURL, err := cmd.Flags().GetString("url")
51: 			if err != nil {
52: 				return err
53: 			}
54: 
55: 			// bind depository server to flag
56: 			_ = viper.BindPFlag("saas.market.server", cmd.Flags().Lookup("host"))
57: 			host := viper.GetString("saas.market.server")
58: 			if host == "" {
59: 				return fmt.Errorf("no host provided")
60: 			}
61: 
62: 			fmt.Printf("creating repository with account %s endorsement \n", accountAddress)
63: 			resp, err := CreateRepo(host, walletDir, accountAddress, repoURL)
64: 			if err != nil {
65: 				return err
66: 			}
67: 			fmt.Print(string(resp))
68: 			return nil
69: 
70: 		},
71: 	}
72: 
73: 	// define flags
74: 	cmd.Flags().StringP("host", "", "", "host URL of market server")
75: 	cmd.Flags().StringP("wallet", "w", common.DefaultWalletConfigDir, "wallet path")
76: 	cmd.Flags().StringP("account", "a", "", "account to be used")
77: 	cmd.Flags().String("repo-url", "", "repository url")
78: 
79: 	// define required flags
80: 	err = cmd.MarkFlagRequired("account")
81: 	if err != nil {
82: 		log.Fatal(err)
83: 	}
84: 	err = cmd.MarkFlagRequired("repo-url")
85: 	if err != nil {
86: 		log.Fatal(err)
87: 	}
88: 
89: 	return cmd
90: }
91: 
92: // CreateRepo creates a new repository on the specified host using the provided account and repo URL.
93: // It returns the response body as a byte slice and any error encountered.
94: func CreateRepo(host string, walletDir string, accountAddress string, repoURL string) ([]byte, error) {
95: 	// Read account info.
96: 	wallet, err := account.NewLocalWallet(walletDir)
97: 	if err != nil {
98: 		return nil, err
99: 	}
100: 	acc, err := wallet.GetAccount(accountAddress)
101: 	if err != nil {
102: 		return nil, err
103: 	}
104: 
105: 	// Get nonce.
106: 	currNonce, err := nonce.Get(host, common.MarketCurrentNonce, acc.Address)
107: 	if err != nil {
108: 		return nil, err
109: 	}
110: 
111: 	// Generate message.
112: 	msgBase64, err := acc.GenerateAndSignMessage(currNonce, repoURL)
113: 	if err != nil {
114: 		return nil, err
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	// POST PutValue request.
118: 	postValue := url.Values{}
119: 	postValue.Add("message", msgBase64)
120: 	postValue.Add("url", repoURL)
121: 
122: 	host = fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", host, common.CreateRepository)
123: 	resp, err := uhttp.Do(host, http.MethodPost, map[string]string{
124: 		"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
125: 	}, []byte(postValue.Encode()))
126: 	if err != nil {
127: 		return nil, err
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	return resp, nil
131: }

38: func NewOrgGetCmd(option common.Options) *cobra.Command {
39: 	var (
40: 		labelSelector string
41: 		fieldSelector string
42: 	)
43: 
44: 	defaultPrintFlag := get.NewGetPrintFlags()
45: 	cmd := &cobra.Command{
46: 		Use: "org [NAME]",
47: 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
48: 			cfg, err := clientcmd.BuildConfigFromKubeconfigGetter("", common.InKubeGetter)
49: 			if err != nil {
50: 				fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
51: 				return err
52: 			}
53: 			cli, err := dynamic.NewForConfig(cfg)
54: 			if err != nil {
55: 				fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
56: 				return err
57: 			}
58: 
59: 			list := corev1.List{
60: 				TypeMeta: v1.TypeMeta{
61: 					Kind:       "List",
62: 					APIVersion: "v1",
63: 				},
64: 				ListMeta: v1.ListMeta{},
65: 			}
66: 			var obj runtime.Object
67: 			if len(args) == 0 {
68: 				orgs, err := cli.Resource(schema.GroupVersionResource{Group: common.IBPGroup, Version: common.IBPVersion, Resource: common.OrganizationResource}).List(context.TODO(), v1.ListOptions{
69: 					LabelSelector: labelSelector,
70: 					FieldSelector: fieldSelector,
71: 				})
72: 				if err != nil {
73: 					fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
74: 					return err
75: 				}
76: 				for i := 0; i < len(orgs.Items); i++ {
77: 					list.Items = append(list.Items, runtime.RawExtension{Object: &orgs.Items[i]})
78: 				}
79: 			} else {
80: 				for _, arg := range args {
81: 					org, err := cli.Resource(schema.GroupVersionResource{Group: common.IBPGroup, Version: common.IBPVersion, Resource: common.OrganizationResource}).Get(context.TODO(), arg, v1.GetOptions{})
82: 					if err != nil {
83: 						fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
84: 						continue
85: 					}
86: 					list.Items = append(list.Items, runtime.RawExtension{Object: org})
87: 				}
88: 			}
89: 
90: 			if len(list.Items) != 1 {
91: 				listData, err := json.Marshal(list)
92: 				if err != nil {
93: 					fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
94: 					return err
95: 				}
96: 				converted, err := runtime.Decode(unstructured.UnstructuredJSONScheme, listData)
97: 				if err != nil {
98: 					fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
99: 					return err
100: 				}
101: 				obj = converted
102: 			} else {
103: 				obj = list.Items[0].Object
104: 			}
105: 
106: 			p, err := defaultPrintFlag.ToPrinter()
107: 			if err != nil {
108: 				fmt.Fprintln(option.ErrOut, err)
109: 				return err
110: 			}
111: 			_ = p.PrintObj(obj, option.Out)
112: 			return nil
113: 		},
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	defaultPrintFlag.AddFlags(cmd)
117: 	cmd.Flags().StringVar(&fieldSelector, "field-selector", "", "Selector (field query) to filter on, supports '=', '==', and '!='.(e.g. --field-selector key1=value1,key2=value2). The server only supports a limited number of field queries per type.")
118: 	cmdutil.AddLabelSelectorFlagVar(cmd, &labelSelector)
119: 
120: 	return cmd
121: }
